content:
Alice S.: ACME Prod reporting intermittent 500s on /v1/generate from dedicated cluster rdp-03. Also seeing token latency spikes (~8-12s). Requests: req_0a1b2c3d, req_9f8e7d6c. Can we gather repro and a debug bundle? Suspect GPU memory pressure.
Mike (oncall): Can you paste a quick curl repro for one of the failing request IDs? Also need pod names and node IDs.
ACME Ops: repro curl below (sanitized). Fails consistently for req_9f8e7d6c from our side.
ACME Ops: ```
curl -v https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"gpt-medium","input":"summarize: large payload","request_id":"req_9f8e7d6c","max_tokens":512}' 
```
ACME Ops: response: ```
HTTP/2 500
content-type: application/json
{ "error": "internal_server_error", "request_id": "req_9f8e7d6c" }
```
Alice S.: Pod names: `ded-acme-inf-0`, `ded-acme-inf-1` (namespace `dedicated-acme`). Node: `gke-ded-rdp-03-1`.
Jess Eng: thx. Can someone run these and paste last 200 lines of inference container logs? quick commands: 
`kubectl -n dedicated-acme logs ded-acme-inf-0 -c inference --tail=200`
`kubectl -n dedicated-acme top pods`
Mike (oncall): I pulled logs from ded-acme-inf-0, attaching snippet — lots of `OOM when allocating tensor` traces and repeated `KV cache transient full` warnings.
Mike (oncall): log snippet: ```
2026-02-14T10:12:34Z ERROR inference ServingError: CUDA out of memory while allocating 134217728 bytes
2026-02-14T10:12:35Z WARN  batching Prefix cache miss, backlog=12
2026-02-14T10:12:35Z ERROR runtime failed to allocate kv cache
```
Kevin SRE: on nodes I see GPU memory frequently at 98-100% in metrics. `nvidia-smi` snapshot shows multiple processes pinned; small allocator churn. dmesg shows Xid 13/79 events.
Kevin SRE: dmesg excerpt: ```
[12345.678901] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:AF:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus
[12345.679012] audit: type=1327 audit(167?): pid=1234 uid=0 : container killed
```
Jess Eng: this looks like a memory fragmentation / slab issue under specific input sizes. Let's get a debug bundle and GPU telemetry for the time window around the request ids. infra-bot, can you run the standard collect script for tenant `acme` and include `req_0a1b2c3d,req_9f8e7d6c`?
infra-bot: Running collection instructions. Use: `sudo /opt/redwood/bin/collect-debug --tenant acme --requests req_0a1b2c3d,req_9f8e7d6c --nodes gke-ded-rdp-03-1 --since 2026-02-14T09:50:00Z`
infra-bot: What it collects: pod logs, node dmesg, `nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY,UTILIZATION`, coredumps (if present), and perf traces. Uploading to s3://redwood-debug/acme/1987654321/. ETA ~8m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ACME Ops: doing `kubectl cp` of inference logs now and will share.
ACME Ops: also captured curl -D - output with headers for req_9f8e7d6c, attaching in thread.
Mike (oncall): For reproducer, try this smaller curl that forces marginal allocation pattern (multi-chunk streaming). Sometimes triggers fragmentation locally: ```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"model":"gpt-medium","input":"lorem\nrepeat large block...","stream":true,"request_id":"local-repro-198765"}' -v
```
Jess Eng: Good. Also run `kubectl exec -n dedicated-acme ded-acme-inf-0 -c inference -- bash -lc "/usr/local/bin/nvprof --track-memory yes --profile-child-processes yes -- /opt/redwood/bin/serve --ptl"` only under guidance; coordinate with me — profiling will impact latency.
Alice S.: infra-bot uploaded initial bundle: s3://redwood-debug/acme/1987654321/bundle.tar.gz (contains logs, nvidia-smi history CSV, dmesg, kubectl-describe, metrics slice). Link visible to ACME Ops and eng.
Kevin SRE: I'll pull the `nvidia-smi` CSV and plot GPU mem usage around 10:12Z. Early look: saw spikes aligning with req_9f8e7d6c with GPU mem climb + frequent cudaFree churn.
Jess Eng: Assigning ENG-3742. I'll triage memory allocator traces and see if recent kernel build or driver update changed behavior. If we can't mitigate, we may temporarily throttle batch size for acme to avoid slab explosion.
Mike (oncall): Action items: 1) ACME Ops — run the curl repro with `stream:true` and paste full verbose output if it fails. 2) Kevin — upload GPU telemetry png to ticket. 3) Jess — check allocator traces, propose short-term config (batch_limit / kv_cache size). 4) Infra — keep debug bundle retention for 30d.
ACME Ops: will run repro test in 10m and post results. Thanks for quick turnaround. :pray: 
Jess Eng: FYI if we need immediate mitigation: set `max_batch_tokens: 256` and `kv_cache_enabled: false` on route to reduce memory pressure; deploy via canary to ded-acme-inf-1 first. I'll draft rollout in ENG-3742.
Mike (oncall): tagging @Jess Eng on the ticket. Closing loop here once we have repro curl output and GPU PNGs.
Alice S.: thanks everyone. Keeping thread open until bundle analysis complete.
